text.en: Shoppers frequently mention the helpfulness of shop assistants, noting welcoming welcomes, product knowledge, and patience when answering pet food questions. Employees receive praise for making visits pleasant, helping customers locate specialty items, and greeting four-legged companions warmly.

Customers appreciate the shop's convenient neighbourhood setting, clean aisles, and swift checkout speeds for routine pet supplies. However, reviewers observe that this smaller format branch carries a narrower range of aquatic and reptile supplies than larger superstores, leading to mixed feedback on overall inventory.

Pet owners appreciate the welcoming atmosphere for dogs visiting the store alongside their families. Reviewers observe that assistants show genuine enthusiasm for animals, making new rescue puppies feel at ease and assisting owners with socialising their pets during shopping trips.

q.en: Can pet owners bring companion animals into the store?

a.en: Yes, customers regularly bring leashed pets into the shop while selecting foods, treats, and accessories.

q.en: Does Petco Lake Highlands stock live feeder insects?

a.en: Yes, reviewers confirm that live crickets and essential reptile supplies are kept in stock for reptile owners.

q.en: Is order pickup or click and collect supported?

a.en: Yes, online orders can be collected at the store or arranged for local home delivery.

q.en: What parking is provided at this shopping location?

a.en: Ample free customer parking is available directly in the surface lot in front of the shop.
